title: I Gave AI a Brain's Emotional Core — Here's What Happened
angle: Framing the AI limbic system not as a coding project but as the moment machines stopped faking emotions and started remembering how to feel — positioning memory and emotion as survival tools, not features.

scenes.scene_name: The Hook — AI Has No Soul. Until Now.
scenes.voiceover: Every AI you've ever used has zero emotional memory. I just changed that.
scenes.visual_description: Black screen. White text slams in: 'AI HAS NO FEELINGS.' Red X crosses it out. New text: 'Until I built this.' Rapid zoom in.
scenes.caption_overlay: I gave AI a limbic system. Watch what it remembers.

scenes.scene_name: The Problem — Why AI Forgets You Every Time
scenes.voiceover: ChatGPT forgets you the second the chat ends. No context. No emotion. No memory. Like meeting a stranger every day.
scenes.visual_description: Split screen: left shows a chat reset, right shows a human visibly frustrated. Text flashes: 'STRANGERS EVERY SESSION.' Quick cut to brain scan MRI.
scenes.caption_overlay: Your AI resets. Every. Single. Time.

scenes.scene_name: The Build — Emotion and Memory as MCP Servers
scenes.voiceover: I built two MCP servers — one stores emotional state, one stores episodic memory. The AI now knows how it felt last time.
scenes.visual_description: Terminal splits into two live windows: 'emotion_server' and 'memory_server'. Code streams in. A JSON blob appears: {mood: frustrated, context: project_deadline}. Zoom punch on the JSON.
scenes.caption_overlay: Two servers. One for feelings. One for memories.

scenes.scene_name: The Reveal — It Remembered How It Felt
scenes.voiceover: I asked it about a project we abandoned. It said — and I quote — 'last time this frustrated us both.' It remembered the emotion.
scenes.visual_description: Chat window shown. AI response highlighted in yellow: 'last time this frustrated us both.' Slow zoom in. Screen shakes on the word 'frustrated.' Text overlay: 'IT REMEMBERED.'
scenes.caption_overlay: It didn't just recall facts. It recalled the feeling.

scenes.scene_name: The Stakes — This Changes Human-AI Interaction Forever
scenes.voiceover: An AI that carries emotional context isn't a tool anymore. It's a collaborator. And we're just getting started.
scenes.visual_description: Fast cuts: human and AI chat glowing warm amber, brain neuron animation, two people collaborating overlaid with circuit lines. Text pulses: 'NOT A TOOL. A COLLABORATOR.'
scenes.caption_overlay: The AI that remembers you is closer than you think.

scenes.scene_name: The Loop — Back to the Question
scenes.voiceover: So ask yourself — if your AI remembered how every conversation felt, would you still say it has no soul?
scenes.visual_description: Screen returns to opening black. White text reappears: 'AI HAS NO FEELINGS.' But this time it glitches, flickers, and the X never appears. Hard cut to black. Loop implied.
scenes.caption_overlay: Still think AI has no feelings?

hook_test.viral_proof: The 'This Changes Everything' format has driven 10M+ views across channels like Fireship, AI Explained, and Theo — t3.gg. Specifically, Fireship's 'I built X in 100 seconds' series and AI Explained's AGI-adjacent reveals consistently clear 10-20M views by opening with a paradigm-breaking claim and delivering a concrete proof within 10 seconds.
hook_test.why_it_works: The hook attacks a deeply held belief (AI has no real memory or emotion) and immediately promises proof. It triggers cognitive dissonance — viewers must keep watching to resolve it. The loop ending rewards rewatches, which the TikTok algorithm amplifies through completion rate signals.
